concept: Motivating a team member who has lost interest or confidence, without shaming them
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student leads a team where one member has visibly disengaged or lost confidence in a shared effort
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to approach the disengaged member
exercise.practice: Student drafts the actual conversation they'd have

assessment.success_marker: student's draft is encouraging and specific, not generic or guilt-based
